_comment: Deliberate differences between Java and Rust. Every entry needs a reason. A route that Rust does not serve yet (missing_route) cannot be allowlisted. Reasons for deliberate Java defects (#162) start with `java-defect`.

entries.reason: java-defect (#162): Java answers 500 for a request without token, Rust 401
java-defect (#162): Java answers 500 (NPE) for missing fields, Rust 422
java-defect (#162): Java answers 500 for an unknown enum value, Rust 422
Java returns {data, meta}, Rust a bare array (#156)
Java creates the owner as PENDING, Rust as APPROVED (#158)
Rust writes no system messages for RSVP/cancel (#159)
Rust does not turn group members into participants (#159)

rust_only.reason: Rust-only route kept with its unchanged answer (ADR-2026-10-20-017, ticket answer 3); the frontend does not use it
Plain-text liveness probe of the Rust backend; Java only has the SmallRye /q/health/* endpoints
